। caturvedavide deyaM SAKABedena yAdava! । ekEkaM paYcakaM deyaM yaTAkAlamidaM Bavet । yaTezwaM lokamApnoti kAmacArI vihaNgamaH” । saNGAwakavrataM varAhapu॰ “SfRuzvEkamanA Badre! saNGAwakamidaM vratam । kaTayAmi mahA pUrvaM brahmaRA kaTitaM mama । mAsasya kArttikasyApi Suklapratipadi vratam । gfhRIyAdekaBaktantu kftvA dantAdiSoDanam । sAyaM saNkalpamADAya dvitIyAyAmupAvaset । tftIyAyAmapi taTA caturTyAM pAraRaM Bavet । SivaM saMpUjayedBaktyA upavAsadvaye'pi ca । yatra vinopacAreRa rAtrO dadyAttato Buvi । svapet prAtaH samutTAya smftvA devaM samarcayet” । santAnadavrata Bavizyottaroktam “kArttikyAmupavAsI yaH kanyAM dadyAt svalaNkftAma । svakIyAM parakIyAM vA nadIsaNgamake SuBe । etata santAnadaM nAma vrataM sugatidAyakam” । santAnAzwamIvrataM vizRuDarmottare “kfzRAzwamyAM cEtramAse snAto niyatamAnasaH । kfzRamaByarcya pUjAYca devakyAH kurute ca yaH । nirAhAro naraH paScAt kfzRAsya jagataH pateH । upozito japanmantraM rAtrO prayatamAnasaH । pUjAyAYcApi kfzRasya sapta vArAn prakIrttayet । pAzaRqinovikarmasTAn vEqAlAn vakanAstikAn । praBAte ca tataH snAto dattvA viprAya dakziRAm । BuYjIta kfta pUjastu kfzRasyEva jagatpateH । vESAKajyEzWayoScEva pAraRaM hi trimAsikam । upozya devadeveSaM Gftena snApayedDarim । AzAQe SrAvaRe cEva mAsi BAdrapade taTA । upozito dvitIyaM vE pAraRaM pUrvavadBavet । ASvine kArttike sOmye tftIyaM pAraRaM taTA । pOze mAGe krAlaguge ca caturTaM dvijasattapa! saptajanmAntarARi tu” । sampUrRavrataM Bavizyottare “saMpUrRaM nAma taccApi vrataM samyak Palapradam । yaccIrRaM naranArIBiryyAvat saMpUrRakAlakam । avaSyantacca karttavyaM saMpUrRaPalakANKiBiH । kiYcidBagnaM pramAdena yadvrataM vratinAM Bavet । tat saMpUrRaM Bavet sarvaM vratenAnena pARqava! । upadravErbahuviDErmahAmohAcca pArTiva! । yadBagnaM kiYcideva syAt vrataM viGnavinAyakEH । tat saMpUrRaM Bavet sarvaM satye satyaM na saMSayaH । kAYcanaM rOpyakaM rUpaM SilpinA tu DawApayet । Bagnavratasya yodevastat svarUpaM sunirmitam । rUpaM strIpuMsayorvApi prArabDaM tadvrataM kila । na ca nizpAditaM kiYciddEvAt sarvaM taTA sTitam । dviBujaM paNkajArUQaM sOmyaM prahasitAnanam” । dviBujAdIni strIpuMsayorUpasya viSezaRam tacca rUpamajYAtezu vratezu, janmAntarakftAnAM vismftAnAYca jYAtatve tezvapIdaM prAyaScittamiti । “nizpAditaM SilpinA ca tasminneva dine punaH । tasmAnmAse punaH prApte brAhmaRo viDinA gfhe । tApayet payasA daDnA GftakzIrarasAmbuBiH । ganDacandanapuzpEstu pUjayet kusumAdinA । toyapUrRasya kumBasya muKe vinyasya candanEH । DUpadIpAkzatErvastrErnAnAbalyupahArakEH । arGyaM dadyAcca tannAmnA mantreRAnena pARqava! । pAzaRqAdiBirAlApamakurvan BAnutatparaH । pUjayet praRato devamekAgramatiraMSupam । mAGAdi pAraRaM mAsEH zaqBiH SucyantakaM smftam” । Sucyantakam AzAQAntakam । “mArttaRqaH praTamaM nAma dvitIyo'rkaH prakIrttitaH । tftIyaM citraBAnustu viBAvasurataHparam । Bageti paYcamo jYeyaH zazWo haMsaH prakIrttitaH । pUrvezu zawsu mAsezu snAnaprASanayostilAH । SrAvaRAdizu mAsezu paYcanavyamudAhftam । snAne ca prASane cEva praSastaM pApanASanam । pratimAsantu devasya kftvA pUjAM yaTAviDi । viprAya dakziRAM dadyAt SraddaDAnaH straSaktitaH । pAraRAnte ca devasya prIRanaM BaktipUrvakam । kurvIta SaktyA viDivadraviM BaktyA divaspatim” sarvAvAptivrataM vizRuDarmottaroktam “idamanyat pravakzyAmi caturmUrttivrataM tava । balaM jYAnaM taTESvaryyaM SaktiSca yadunandana! daDikAlAguruYcEva lalAwe tilakaM nyaset । SilAruRadalEScEva sOBAmbArogyakfdyataH । srajaM kuNkumatAmbUlaM sindUraM raktamAsalI । vitaret sopavAsA hi nArI maNgalyavardDanam । viDavA tu viraktAni kumArI SuklavAsalI । tataH svaBavame BAnuM pUjayet SItalodakEH । aparAhle tataH snAtvA sunOnI niyatavrataH । pratimAM stapayedBAnoH paYcaganDyena vAriRA । raktacandanapaNkena kuNkumena samABet । agastyakusumEraktEH karavIrEH prapUjayet” । sUryyasaptamIvrataM vizRuDarmottare “cEtre Suklasya pakze tu samyak zazWyAmupozitaH । saptamyAmarcanaM kuryyAddevadevasya rBUpate! । vahiHsnAnaM naraH kftvA gomayenopalepitaH । lepayetsTaRqilaM samyak tato gOramfdA nfpa! । tatrAzwadalakamalaM varRakEstu samaM liKet” ityAdi । somadvitIyAvrataM padmapu॰ “dadyAtsitadvitIyAyAM sinDorkavaRaBojanam । samApte goprado yAti viprAya Sivagandiram” viprAya sinDorlavaRaBojanaM dadyAdityanvayaH । sozaScAtra devatA somavratamidaM smftamiti somasya devatAtvaM gamyate । “kalpAnte rAjarAjasya momavratamidaM smftam” । somavrataM kAlottare “candrAzwamyAM rohiRI syAttadA candra vrataYcaret । SivaM sampUjya viDivat snAneH paYcAmftAdiBiH । vilepanantu candreRa candanena tu vA hitam । SuklavastrEstaTA puzpEH pUjayet parameSvaram । nEvedyaM kzIrakumBantu sitaSarkarayA yutam । prASanaM candanenEva rAtrI jAgaraRaM hitam । AyuHkAmEH sadA kAryyaM kIrttiSrIsADane hitam । iti candravrataM nAmodAradAnena jA yate” । kAlikApu॰ “vAre somasya vAzwamyAM pakzoBO sAmamarcayet । viDinA candracUqANke prAjyAnnena sacandrakam” । pakzoBO atroBayatra pakze niyaBo'zWamIsomayArayoH saMyogamAtraM vivakzitaM, prAjyAnnaM AjTabahulamannam । “da kziRArdDaM haranDyAyedvAmordDantu hariM viBum” । ityAdi “azwamyAM pitarAvarcya viDinAnena suvrata!” । pitarO tAveva devIdevO “vatsarantu tadante tu karttavyaM yanniboData । prAguktaviDinA pUjya sitaM pItaM yugadvayam । dadyAdvitAnake cEva patAkATaRwike taTA । DUpasaYcAraRe cAzi dIpavfkzO suSoBinO” । Bavizyapu॰ “tAmrapAtra payaHpUrRaM kftvA tatsTaYca SaNkaram । pracCAdyoparivastreRa ganGapuzpArcitaM mahat । SivaBakte dvije dadyAdBojayitvA viDAnataH । prAcyAM samudite some gatocyAYca ravA gate । pOrRamAsyAM tu vESAKyAM gfhapAtraM SizAya tu । prIyatAM me mahAdevaH somamUrttirjagatpAtaH । tasmE viprAya tatpAtramarcayedBaktitaH SanEH । evaM somavrataM nAma kftvA somAntikaM vrajet” । somavAravrataM mavizyottare “tadvaccitrAsu saMprApya somavAraM vicakzaRaH । naktoktaviDinA sarvaM kuryyAt pUjAdikaM viDoH । saptame tu tataH prApte dattvA brAhmaRaBojanam । kAMsyapAtre tu saMsTApya somaM rajatasamBavam” । somarUpantu caturdaSIsTamahArAjavratoktaM veditavyam “pAtre kftvA somarAja SvetavastrEH prapUjitam । pAdukopAnahacCatraBAjanAsanasaMyutam । homaM GftatilEH kuryyAt somanAmrA tu mantravit । samiDo'zwottaraSatamazwAviMSatireva vA । hotavyA maDusarpiByAM daDnA ceva Gftena tu” ityAdi । somAzwamIvrataM skandapu॰ “vAre somasya cAzwamyAM pakzayorumaryArapi । viDivaccandracUqABaM somaM sampUjayenniSi” । somaM umAsahitam rUpantu kfzRAzWamyAmeva vyAKyAtam । “tilasarzapakalkena snAto'malajalASaye । gfhe yAyatane vApi SivEkAhitamAnasaH । brahmakUrcena deveSaM prASayitvA tato vratI” । brahmakUrcaM paYcagavyama “vAmAdiyAmamantrESca devaM devIM taTArcayet । candanenenduyukten dakziRArdDaM vilezayet” ityAdi । sORyavrataM Bavizyapu॰ “ekAdaSyAM mAzamAse caturdaSyazwamIzu ca । ekaBaktena yo dadyAt celakAnyarjunAni ca । upAnahI kambalaYca pAtraM citraM taTodakam । karapAtrAdikaM vatsa! yaTASaktyArTine nfpa! । ArttatrARaparo nityamaYcameDaPalaM laBet । etatsIKyavrataM nAma Artta trARakaraM param” । sOganDyavrataM padmapu॰ “varjayed yastu puzpARi hemantamiSire vratI । patratrayaYca PAlgunyAM kftvA SaktyA ca kAYcanam । dadyAdvEkAlavelAyAM prIyetAM SivakeSavO । SiraHsOmanDyajananaM sadAnandaprada nfRAm । kftvA paraM padaM yAti sOganDyavratamuttamam” । sOBAgyatftIyAvrataM varAhapu॰ “ataHparaM mahArAja! sOBAgyakaraRaM vratam । SfRu yenASu sOBAgyaM strIpuM sAmaBijAyate । PAlagunasya tu mAmasya tftIyA SuklapakzataH । upozitena naktena SucinAsatyaBAziRA । saSrIkaYca hariM pUjya rudraM vA umayA saha” ityAdi । garuqapu॰ “PAlgunAdivftIyAyAM lavaRaM yastu varjayet । samAnte SayanaM dadyAt gfhaM sopaskarAnvitam” । samAnte vatsarAnte “saMpUjya vipramiTunaM BavAnI prIyatAmiti । gOrIlokapradaM nityaM sOBAgyavratamucyate” । sOBAgyavrataM Bavizyapu॰ “pOrRamAsyAM tu yaH somaM pUjayed BaktimAnnaraH । sOBAgyaYca Bavettasya iti me niScita matiH । mUlamantrAH srasaMjYABiraNgamantrASca kIrttitAH” ityAdi । sOBAgyaSayanavrataM matsyapu॰ “taTEvAnyat pravakzyAmi sava kAmaPalapradam । sOBAgyaSayanaM nAma yat purARavidobiduH” । ityupakrame “vasantamAsamAsAdya tftIyAyAM janapriyAm । Suklapakzasya pUrvAhRe tilEHsnAnaM samAcaret । tasminnahani sA devI kila viSvAtmanA satI । pARigrahaRakEH mantrErudUvA varavarRinI । tayA sahEva deveSaM tftIyAyAM samarcayet” ityAdi । “evaM saMvatsarAM yAvat tftIyAyAM sadA mano! । prASane dAnamantre ca viSezo'yaM nisADa me । goSfNgodakamAQyaM syAd vESAKe gomayaM punaH । jyEzWe mandArakusumaM vilvapatraM SucO smftam । SrAvaRe daDi mamprASya naBasye ca kuSodakam । kzIramASvayuje mAsi kArttike pfzadAjyakam” । pfzadAjyaM daDimiSraM Dftam “mArgaSIrze tu gomUtraM pOze samprASayed vftam । mAze kfzRatilAMstadvat paYcagavyaYca PAlgule । lacitA vijayA BadrA BavAnI kumudA SivA । vAsudevI taTA gOrI maNgalA kamalA satI । uBA ca dAnakAle tu prIyatAmiti kIrttayet । mallikA'SokakamalakadambotpalamAlatIm । kulatTaM karavIraYca vARamamlAnakuNkumam । sinduvAraYca sarvezu mAsezu kra BataH smftam” ityAdi । sOBAgyasaMkrAntivrata skandapu॰ “aTArmyA pravakzyAmi sOBAgyasaMkrAntimuttamAm । SfRu nArada! yatnena DanESvaryyapradAyinIm । ayane vizuve yukte vyatIpAtena BAnunA । saMkrAntidivase kuryyAdekaBaktaM bimatsaraH । pUrvavadBAnumaByarcya taTA cEva suvAsine । sOBAgyAzwakasaMyuktaM vastrayugmaM sayozite । viprAya vedaviduze BaktyA tat vratipAdayet । evaM saMvatsare pUrRe kftvA brAhmaRaBojanam । parvataM lavaRaM kftvA yaTAviBavasArataH । kAYcanaM kamalaM kftvA BAskaraYcEva kArayet । ganDapuzyAdinA pUjya viprAya pratipAdayet” । sOBAgyAvAptivrataM vizRuDarmottare “mAGyAntu samatItAyAM patipatpraBftikramAt । pawe vA yadi vArccAyAM kfzRaM saMpUjayet sadA । pUrboktaM sakala kuryyAd viDiM cAtra narADiza!” । pUrvoktamiti cEtramAsasambanDirUpAmApivratoktamityarTaH । “nityaM samAcaret snAna taTA ganDapriyaNguRA । caruM priyaNguRA kuryyAdDomaM kuryyAt priyaNgaRA” । ziyaNguH kaNgusadfSaganDadravyam “kAlagunyAntu tato dadyAt trirAtropozito naraH । vastre ca deye nfpa! kuNkumAkte kzAdrasya pAtraYca taTEva kAMsyam । sOBAgyada hyetadanu ttamante vrataM mamEtatkaTita nfvora .” । sOranaktavrataM nfsiMhapu॰ “hastayukte vArkadine sOranaktavrataM caret । snAvvAByarcya tu viprAn vE virogo jAyate naraH” । sOrasaptamIvrataM padmapu॰ “yaScopabAsI saptamyAM samAnte hemapaNkajam । gAScEva SaktitodadyAdDomAnte GawasaMyutAH । etat sOravrataM nAma sUryyalokapradAyakam” । strIputrakAmAvAptivrataM Bavizyapu॰ “ekaBaktena yA nArI kArttikantu kzapennfpa! । kzamAhiMsAdiniyamEH saYjAtA brahmacAriRI । guqAnnamiSraM SAlyannaM BAskarAya nivedayet । puzpARi karavIrARi guggulaM sAjyamAdarAt । saptamyAYcATa zazwyA vA upavAsaratirBavet । pakzayoruBayoreva SradDayA parayAnvitaH । indranIlapratIkASErvimAnEH sArvakAmikEH । nArI yuMnaSataM sAgraM sUryyaloke mahI yate” varzasADyamidam । snehavrataM padmapu॰ “AzAQAdicaturmAsAnaByaNgaM varjayennaraH । pArite ca punardadyAttilatElayuta Gawam । BojanaM pAyasAjyaYca sa yAti BavanaM viBoH । lokaprItikaraM hyetat snehavratihocyate” । hayapaYcamIvrataM SAlihotre “aSvarAqamftAjjAto vAtaraMhA manojavaH । uccEHSravAH pUjanIyaScEtraSukusya paYcamI । tatrEva pUjyA ganDarvAsturaNgARAntu bAnDavAH । patravARa DarAH kecit kecit patrESca saMyutAH । BImaScitraraTaScEva viKyAtaH sarvavidayam । taTA sAliSirAH SrImAn pradyumnaSca mahAyaSAH । nAradaSca kalindaSca ganDarvaSca hAhA huhUH । suvAhustumburuScEva taTA citraraTaH praBuH । citrANgadaSca viKyAtaScitrasenaSca vIryyavAn । sidDapUrRaSca vadarI parRASaSca mahAyasAH । brahmacArI ratiguRaH suparRo'tibalastaTA । viSvAvasuH surendraSca ganDarvo'viparAkramaH । ityete pUjanIyAH syugIrtiruccAvacEH SuBEH । modakEH polikABiSca paramAnnena cAkzatEH । daDnA guqena payasA SAlipizwena BUriSaH । DUpErmAlyEstaTA dIpErdvijAnAM svAstavAcanEH । evaM hi pUjitAH samyak turagARAM hi bAnDavAH । balamAyuH prayacCanti saMgrAmezvaparAjayam । ArogyaM paramA puzwistaTEva ca viDIyate” । haratftIyAvrataM skandapu॰ “mAGe SuklatftIvAyAmupavAsantu kArayet । rAtrO samBAramAhftya gOrIyAgasya maRqape । aTa patra liKet padmaM maRqape munipuNgava! । umAmaheSvaraM tatra pUjayet susamAhitaH । pUrvapatre nyased gOrImAgneyyAM lalitAM nyaset । dakziRe tu damAM nAma nErftyAM ca svaDAM taTA । paScime vAmadevIntu vAyavyAM mUlagOrikAm । uttare tu suBagAntu EcAmyAM girijAM taTA । umAmaheSvaraM maDye ganDapuzpEH prapUjayet । BfNgAraYcEva saMsTApya taRqulEH paripUrayet । evaM kftvA viDAnena mune! varzacatuzwayam । ArADanantu devyASca sOBAgyajananaM param । udyApanaM tataH kuryyAt tasminneva tato dine । umAmaheSvaraM hEmaM svacCande maYcake sTitam । vastrErganDESa DUpaSca dIpamAlAdiBistayA । BakzyEtAMnAviDEH samyak pUjya BaktyA tato mune! । tadvadguruM saBAryyaYca pUjayet dvijasattamam । gAYcEva gurave tadvat yastrAlaNkArarsayutAm । miTunAnIha catvAri Bojayet susamAhitaH । umAmaheSvaraM hEmaM dattvA BaktyA kzamApayet” । haravrataM Bavizyapu॰ “azwamyAM pUjito devI goSrutABaraRo haraH । jYAnaM dadAtiM vipulAM kAntiM jAtiM bala taTA” । goSrutABaraRaH cakzuHSravoBUzaH Siva ityarTaH । “mfvyuhA jYAnadaScEva pApahAH prapUjitaH । mUlamantraH svasajYABi raNgamantrASca kIrcitAH । pUrvavat padmapatrasTaH karttavyaScatiToSvara । ganDapuzpopahArESca yaTASakti viDIyate” । harivrate varAhapu॰ “trElokyagAminI devI lakzmIste'stu sadA priyA । dvAdaSI ca tiTiste'stu kAmarUpI ca jAyate” । hariM pratIdaM bacanam “GftASano Baved yastu dvAdaSyAM tatparAyaRaH । sa svargavAsI Bavati pumAn strI nA viSezataH” । harikAlovrataM Bavizyottare “Sukle BAdrapadasyEvaM tftIyAyAM samAcarat । ratnaDAnyEH savErUQEH kftvA vihitaSAdvale । KarjUrErnArikelESca PalESca maDurEstaTA । mAtulANgakusurmEDAnyakErjambukEstaTA । ganDEH puzpEH PalErDUpErnEvedyErmodakAdiBiH । prIRayitvA samAsAdya padmarAgeRa BAvitA । GaRwAvAdyAdiBirgItEH SuBErdivyEH kaTAnakEH । pUjanIyA mahArAja! mantreRAnena BaktritaH । harernAmnaH samutpanne! harikAli! haripriye! । sarvadA SasyamUrttisTe! praRatArttihare! namaH । itTaM saMpUjya tAM devIM dadyAdviprAya dakziRAm । kftvA jAnaraRaM rAtrO praBAta kiYcidudgate । rAtrO suvAsinIBiSca sA neyA tu jalASaye । tato jalApaye ramye mantreREva visarjayet । acitA ca mayA BaktyA gacCa devi! surAlayam । mama dOrBAgya nASAya punarAgamanAya ca । evaM yaH pARqavaSrezWa! haMrikAvIvrataM caret । prativarzaM viDAnena nArI vA BaktitatparA । nItvA yat PalamApnoti tadanyena na laByate” । pariSizwam । AmalakEkAdaSoDataM skandapu॰ praBAsaKa॰ “PAlgunasya site pakze ekAdaSyAmupozitaH । snAtvA nadyAM taqAge vA vApyAM kUpe gfhepi vA । gatvA girO vane vApi yatra sA prApyate SivA । kzorode maTyamAne tu yadA vfkzaH samutTitaH । AmardandevadEtyAnAM tena sAmalakI smftA । tasmin vfkze sTitA lakzmIH sadA pitfgfhe nfpa! । SivAlakzmIsTino vfkzaH mevyate surasattamEH । devErbrahmAdiBiH sarvErvfkzo'sO vEzRavaH kftaH । tatra gatvA hariH pUjyo vfkzamUle'Ta vA SivA । pUjyA pumbEH SuBErAtrO kAryyaM jAgaraRaM narEH । azwADikaSatEH kAryyA PalEstasyAH pradakziRA । pradakziRIkftya tato॰ BoktavyaM tu PalaM narEH । karakaM jalapUrRaM tu karttavyaM pAtrasaMyutam । havizyAnnantu karttavyaM kaTASravaRatatparEH । mucyante dehinaH pApEH kalijEH kAyasamBavEH । dehAnte ye narAH pUrvaM pUjyante harimandiram” । etAni vratAni prAyeRa hemAdrivrataKaRqoktAni prasaNgAMgatAnyapi kAniciduktAni । anyAnyapi vratArkAdAvuktAni dfSyAni nEmittikAni prAjApatyAdIni vratAni tu tattacCabde uktAni dfSyAni ।
m: व्रत n. (ifc. f(आ). ; fr. √ 2. वृ) will, command, law, ordinance, rule, RV.
sphere of action, function, mode or manner of life (e.g. शुचि-व्र्˚, ‘pure manner of life’, Śak.), conduct, manner, usage, custom, RV. &c. &c.

a religious vow or practice, any pious observance, meritorious act of devotion or austerity, solemn vow, rule, holy practice (as fasting, continence &c.; व्रतं-√ चर्, ‘to observe a vow’, esp. ‘to practise chastity’), ib.
any vow or firm purpose, resolve to (dat. loc., or comp.; व्रतात् or व्रत-वशात्, ‘in consequence of a vow’; cf. असि-धारा-व्रत and आसिधारं व्रतम्), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the practice of always eating the same food (cf. मधु-व्र्˚), L.
the feeding only on milk (as a fast or observance according to rule; also the milk itself), VS.; Br.; KātyŚr.
= महा-व्रत (i.e. a partic. Stotra, and the day for it), Br.; ŚrS.;
(with gen. or ifc.) N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr. (L. also ‘month’; season; year; fire; ‘= Viṣṇu’; ‘N. of one of the seven islands of Antara-dvīpa’)

व्रत mfn. = वेद-व्रत, one who has taken the vow of learning the Veda, Gṛhyās. ii, 3 (Sch.)
a: व्रतः --तं — [व्रज्-घ जस्य तः] 1 A religious act of devotion or austerity, vowed observance, a vow in general; अभ्यस्यतीव व्रतमासिधारं R. 13. 67, 2. 4, 25; (there are several vratas enjoined in the different Purāṇas; but their number cannot be said to be fixed, as new ones, e. g. सत्यनारायणव्रत, are being added every day.) --2 A vow, promise, resolve; सोऽभूद् भग्नव्रतः शत्रूनुद्धृत्य प्रतिरोपयन् R. 17. 42; so सत्यव्रत, पुण्यव्रत, दृढव्रत &c. --3 Object of devotion or faith, devotion; as in पतिव्रता (पतिर्व्रतं यस्याः सा); यांति देवव्रता देवान् पितॄन् यांति पितृव्रताः Bg. 9. 25. --4 A rite, an observance, practice, as in अर्कव्रत q v. --5 Mode of life, course of conduct; Ś. 5. 27. --6 An ordinance, a law, rule. --7 Sacrifice. --8 An act, a deed, work. --9 A design, plan. --Comp. --आचरणं the observance of a vow. --आदेशः investiture of a youth (of any one of the three classes) with the sacred thread. --उपवासः a fast for a vow. --ग्रहणं initiation into a vow for a religious performance. --चर्यः a religious student; see ब्रह्मचारिन्. --चर्या observance or practice of a religious vow. --पारणं, --णा conclusion of a vow or fast, eating after a fast. --प्रतिष्ठा performance of a religious vow voluntarily undertaken. --भंगः {1} breach of a vow. {2} breach of a promise. --भिक्षा begging alms as part of the ceremony of investiture with the sacred thread. --लोपनं breaking a vow. --वैकल्यं the incompletion of a religious vow. --संग्रहः initiation into a vow. --स्थ a. practising any vow. --स्नातकः a Brāhmaṇa who has completed the first stage of his religious life, i. e. that of a Brahmacārin or religious student; see स्नातक.
